question: Build an absenteeism report
description: Review quarterly absence and compare departments with the prior quarter. All records are illustrative aggregates.

sources.label: Dataset
sources.value: Fictional attendance and payroll aggregates for 318 employees.

sources.label: Absence rate
sources.value: Absent scheduled days divided by total scheduled workdays.

sources.label: Cost
sources.value: Absent days multiplied by an illustrative average daily cost.

findings.label: Operations
findings.value: Review scheduling and workload with the team.

findings.label: Next step
findings.value: Track quarterly rates before attributing changes to interventions.

findings.label: Company trend
findings.value: Absence declined across all three departments shown.

findings.label: Operations
findings.value: Highest rate at 6.2%; review workload and offer team support.

findings.label: Next step
findings.value: Evaluate a flexible scheduling pilot using the next quarter's data.
